PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

3. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.

6. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A mixture of two liquids

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.

15. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Quantity of Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
